name: Rapid Throw on the action bar is saved as Throw Weapon (#5469)
contract: Gurubashi Technique 705198 gives a 25% chance on a Throw-family cast (SpellFamilyName 18, SpellFamilyFlags[1] & 262144) to grant the Gurubashi Technique buff 706487 (AscensionBarbarianCompletion.cpp:407-408). aura_ascension_barbarian_lifecycle::Apply on 706487 (AscensionBarbarianCompletion.cpp:273-281) teaches Rapid Throw 807482 with learnSpell(807482, true), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement over every active Throw-family spell except 807236, Throw Weapon Rank 1 804136 among them. Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 807482 for a button holding Rapid Throw, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before the buff teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. The fixture applies 706487 directly instead of rolling the 25% proc. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Rapid Throw must be saved as Throw Weapon; a button holding Throw Weapon is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The buff replaces Throw Weapon with Rapid Throw
The Rapid Throw button is saved as Throw Weapon
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
